name: Arcane University
description: Next to the Dawn of Light city, there is an immense campus of the largest arcane university in Tanares. With eight large towers, one for each school of magic, and many other structures, including a small floating island, it is the best place to learn spells. It is full of large halls with decorations based on arcane spells and corridors connecting various locations. Legends even speak of a vast dungeon underground. Families pay large amounts of gold for their children’s admission; still, there is a long waiting list. It is both a place of study and competition; from early on, students are motivated to elevate the prestige of their respective towers above the others. The time required to earn an arcane certificate is ten years, with four years of basic subjects, four years for advanced subjects, and another two years for specialization. Many tests occur along the way, and only a third of the initial students complete the course. This place is mainly enhanced by magic and contains many interesting features: Arcane Mirrors. Students have in their rooms a special mirror capable of communicating with other students and their tutors. Living paintings. Some paintings move, showing a sequence of actions for learning or entertainment purposes. Chrono Chamber. Inside this room, the time passes ten times slower than the outside. It is used when students need to study before the tests. On the floating islands, there are some locations related to each school tower: • Abjuration: The Barrier Wards • Conjuration: The Summoning Circle • Divination: The Oracle’s Pool • Enchantment: Hall of Whispers • Evocation: The Arcane Arenas • Illusion: The Mirage Labyrinth • Necromancy: The Ancestral Tombs • Transmutation: The Alchemical Gardens
